# knbsdata

<!-- badges: start -->
[![Lifecycle: experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html#experimental)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/Mustapha-Wasseja/knbsdata/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Mustapha-Wasseja/knbsdata/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

`knbsdata` is an R client and standardisation layer for discovering,
downloading, documenting and analysing official statistics published by the
Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (KNBS).

The package aims to make it straightforward to find the right dataset,
understand its metadata and access conditions, retrieve it in a consistent tidy
shape, keep the provenance attached to the data, and cite it correctly.

## Scope

**Implemented: surveys, publications, and indicators — census, prices, the
economy, and Gross County Product.**

- **Surveys**, against the Kenya National Data Archive: search studies, read
  their full documentation, search their variables, and list their data files —
  with provenance and citations attached throughout.
- **Publications**, against the KNBS website's media library: search roughly
  1,600 statistical releases, reports and workbooks, and download them with
  verification, SHA-256 checksums and a provenance sidecar.
- **Census tables**, against the KNBS census data service: the 2019 Population
  and Housing Census as tidy observations, with geography down to sub-county
  and an explicit CC BY 4.0 licence.
- **Consumer prices**, against the KNBS CPI Explorer: the monthly index and
  inflation from January 2009, nationally and by the CPI collection strata,
  plus the retail prices of the CPI basket commodities.
- **The economy**, against the KNBS Data Portal: 323 SDMX dataflows — GDP by
  activity and expenditure, trade, balance of payments, county government
  finance, employment and more.
- **Gross County Product and the republished datasets**, against Kenya Open
  Data for Africa: GCP for all 47 counties (2013–2020, constant and current
  prices) plus 200 more datasets from KNBS, the Central Bank of Kenya and
  partner agencies — with republisher provenance stated on every result.
- **Statistical Abstract tables as tidy data**: the 2025 edition's National
  Accounts chapter — production accounts, GDP, expenditure, capital
  formation, income and saving — extracted from the official workbooks by
  hand-verified recipes that are re-checked on every read.
- **Geographic reference codes**: Kenya, its 47 counties and their
  sub-counties in the 2019 census frame, with names, parent codes and an
  explicit vintage — the join keys the census tables themselves use.

Not implemented:

- **The newest Gross County Product years as data.** The data version is the
  2021 edition (through 2020); the editions since exist only as PDF reports —
  find and download them through
  `knbs_publications("gross county product")`.
- **Boundary geometries, other geographic vintages, crosswalks and
  classifications** — nothing verified, so nothing served.
- **Microdata downloads.** The survey archive requires an account for every
  download. `knbs_download_microdata()` explains the official process and
  stops; the package does not automate sign-in or licence acceptance.
- **Survey documentation files.** The archive publishes no machine-readable
  listing of questionnaires or reports.

`vignette("source-status")` states all of this in full. Findings are in
[`dev/source-discovery/source-audit.md`](dev/source-discovery/source-audit.md).

## Installation

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Mustapha-Wasseja/knbsdata")
```

## What works today

```{r}
library(knbsdata)

# Which sources does the package know about, and how far are they verified?
knbs_sources()
```

```{r}
# Is anything answering? This form contacts nothing; knbs_status(live = TRUE) does.
knbs_status()[, c("source_id", "status", "message")]
```

Surveys (these contact the archive, so they are not run here):

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Find a study
studies <- knbs_search_surveys("household budget")

# Read its documentation
meta <- knbs_survey_metadata("KEN-KNBS-KIHBS-2015-2016-v01")
knbs_cite(meta)

# Search its variables without downloading any microdata
knbs_variables("KEN-KNBS-KIHBS-2015-2016-v01", search = "expenditure")

# See what it holds, and on what terms
knbs_survey_files("KEN-KNBS-KIHBS-2015-2016-v01")
```

Publications (also live requests, not run here):

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Find publications
pubs <- knbs_publications("economic survey", year = 2026)

# Download one: verified, checksummed, with a provenance sidecar
knbs_download_publication(pubs$publication_id[[1]], "data/publications")
```

Indicators (live requests, not run here):

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Monthly CPI and inflation, from 2009
cpi <- knbs_get_indicator("CPI_ALL_ITEMS", start = "2020-01")
knbs_get_indicator("CPI_INFLATION_YOY", geo_level = "region")

# Gross County Product, all 47 counties, 2013-2020
gcp <- knbs_get_indicator("jhbzkjc")

# The Statistical Abstract's National Accounts tables, tidy
knbs_abstract_tables()
gdp <- knbs_abstract_table("2.2")

# County populations from the 2019 census, leading-zero codes intact
pop <- knbs_get_indicator("POPCEN0001", geo_level = "county")
knbs_cite(pop)

# The matching reference codes, for joins
knbs_geographies(level = "county")
```

## What it will look like

Specified but not yet implemented:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
knbs_search("consumer price index")
```

## Access conditions

`knbsdata` will not circumvent registration requirements, licence agreements,
approval processes, authentication, rate limits or robots exclusions. Datasets
that require authorised access are represented in the catalogue with their
access conditions, but are not downloaded: the package points you at the
official access process instead.

Retrieved data and publications remain subject to KNBS terms and licences. The
MIT licence in this repository covers the software only.

## Sources change

Official portals are re-organised from time to time. When a source changes shape
the package should fail with a clear, classed error rather than return
incomplete data. If you hit one, please open a
[data source change issue](https://github.com/Mustapha-Wasseja/knbsdata/issues/new/choose).

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), including the checklist for adding a new
source adapter. Please note that this project is released with a
[Contributor Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Disclaimer

`knbsdata` is an independent open-source software project designed to facilitate
access to publicly available statistics and metadata published by the Kenya
National Bureau of Statistics. It is not an official KNBS product unless and
until KNBS formally adopts or endorses it. Users should consult the original
KNBS source for authoritative definitions, revisions, access conditions and
official releases.
